brief:
Shehab Wire reports that Palestinian photographs and audio recordings long hidden by decades of conflict and persecution have emerged into public view, Shehab Wire reported. The materials reveal historical accounts previously kept behind closed doors, restoring access to documentation obscured during years of war and displacement.

The archival project addresses what organizers describe as a battle for Palestinian historical memory, recovering evidence of events and experiences that official channels had withheld or concealed. The release of these primary sources makes available to the public a significant body of Palestinian historical testimony.
